description: Interactive experiences that need to run all day: clear UI, solid logic, integrations, and on-site delivery.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Public-facing interactive applications installed on site. The real challenge: an experience that feels smooth, is understood in a few seconds, and stays reliable over time.

  • Short flows, readable UI, fast startup.
  • Robustness: guardrails, clean restart, clear feedback.
  • Content and scenarios that can evolve without rewriting everything.

sections.title: My role
sections.content:
• Owned end-to-end: design, development, integrations, and on-site delivery.
  • Field debugging: understand fast, fix properly, avoid regressions.
  • Stack as needed: C#, HTML/CSS/JS, and targeted integrations.
